scope: Item 4 credit-sales v1: quotation approval, full delivery and customer invoice, billing notice, partial/final collections and receipts

behavior.catalog: Existing company CRM customers and products; prices/VAT from server catalog, no client override; immutable approved values
behavior.approval: Different actor required with accounting.invoice.approve; permission registered but not automatically granted to staff
behavior.fulfillment: Full delivery only; stock availability excludes reservations; stock movement, COGS, AR/revenue, invoice, delivery and snapshots commit atomically
behavior.collections: Cash or manually verified bank transfer; partial/final, receipt idempotency and per-invoice duplicate evidence protection; no provider verification or automatic debit
behavior.accounting: Shared journal source idempotency retained; stable globally unique JE numbers and company posting lock prevent sequence collision/lost balance updates
behavior.documents: Five new kinds in document center, immutable issuance evidence, history and original/copy downloads; no accounting on quotation/billing/export
behavior.internal_company: Matching company/customer tax ID blocks internal sale; use existing stock transfers. Recognized other-company buyer recorded without auto-posting in buyer company
behavior.cancel: Before delivery only; issued quotation retained with cancellation event, no stock or ledger reversal needed

isolated_postgres: Migration restored from live backup; concurrent create and approval replay, maker-checker
Injected evidence failure rolls back delivery/stock/AR; concurrent delivery issues once
Balanced goods revenue/VAT/COGS; partial/final receipt with concurrent overpayment rejection
Duplicate receipt request/evidence protection; five document kinds and rendered PDF
Buyer snapshot unchanged after customer edit; company/branch/permission boundaries
Same-company transfer rejection, stock shortage, Retail data-source protection, closed period, pre-delivery cancellation
Existing AP payment/WHT regression passes with new journal numbering/serialization
verification.repeat_policy: Only failed tablet-label case rerun after accessible-label correction; two missing unit modules mounted and run separately; full successful financial flow not repeated
verification.live_smoke: Scoped list/options read-only; schema/routes/source routing verified, no live credit-sale records created
verification.rollback: Prior application imported and read expanded schema on disposable clone; rollback script syntax checked, previous images retained; not executed against healthy live UAT this release

rollback.policy: Roll back application images only. Keep expanded schema, financial balances and evidence. Pause credit sales/collections until forward recovery; never restore database over new transactions.

not_in_v1: Production is explicitly blocked by environment/hostname guard; accounting acceptance pending
Documents are UAT/non-fiscal; no official tax invoice, tax filing or legal certification. Stored VAT used only for UAT accounting rehearsal; tax points/service VAT require accountant acceptance
No partial delivery, quotation price override, editable draft revisions, consolidated multi-invoice billing or allocation
No customer withholding deductions, returns, credit notes, refund/reversal workflow after delivery
No variant/composite/recipe execution; current simple/service products only
No separated Retail/Takeaway stock source integration; goods requiring that source are rejected rather than rerouted
No auto-posting to the buyer company, credit limits, collection reminders or bank verification
Shared POS sales dashboard/report integration not added; journals are available via accounting, outstanding amounts on credit-sales page
Items 5 aging/due reporting and 6 cost/break-even reports remain separate work
Human accountant approval and physical printing remain pending
